question: Which bodily regions and sides receive protective coverage here?
premises: Protection is invoked in the region of the back
Protection is invoked in the secret part
Protection is invoked on the left and right sides
inference: The back, secret part, and both sides are designated for protection.
uncertainties: The protecting deity is not named in this verse and may be carried from context.
plain_english: In the region of the back, likewise in the secret part, and on the left and right sides as well.
